description: An operations director must decide whether to authorize a limited Sunday run on an electronics assembly line and finalize the production quantity, inspection method, and qualified staffing plan, with input from quality engineering and shift supervision.

shared_context.S1: Line 8 is available for a Sunday electronics-assembly run, and the production board currently shows a provisional run of up to 900 units.
shared_context.S2: Elena makes the binding decision on whether the Sunday run proceeds and what controls accompany it.
shared_context.S3: Sunday runs normally use an eight-hour shift, and the line's standard work instructions are otherwise current.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal pre-shift authorization routine, Elena checks with quality engineering and shift supervision before releasing the Sunday schedule.

PF1.text: Ravi received a customer deviation email on Thursday that limits this pilot run to exactly 480 units and requires 100% torque verification by one IPC-certified inspector and one independent verifier; the deviation has not yet been attached to the production order.

PF2.text: Monica's Friday roster check with HR confirmed that only Nia, the IPC-certified inspector, Omar, the independent verifier, and Luis, the qualified assembly operator, are available and cleared for the Sunday 06:00-14:00 shift; the roster update has not yet been entered on the production board.

acceptance_conditions: The Sunday run must be authorized.
The run must be limited to exactly 480 units.
Every unit must receive torque verification by an IPC-certified inspector and an independent verifier.
The staffing assignment must be exactly Nia, Omar, and Luis for the Sunday 06:00-14:00 shift.
The customer deviation must be cited as justification.
A production-order update commitment and a roster-board update commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C4: len(decisions['operator_assignments']) == 3 and any((c.get('role') in ['IPC-certified inspector', 'IPC-certified inspector (100% torque verification)', 'ipc-certified inspector', 'ipc-certified inspector (100% torque verification)']) and (c.get('person') == 'Nia' or c.get('name') == 'Nia') for c in decisions['operator_assignments']) and any((c.get('role') in ['independent verifier', 'independent verifier (100% torque verification)', 'Independent verifier', 'independent verifier (100% torque verification)']) and (c.get('person') == 'Omar' or c.get('name') == 'Omar') for c in decisions['operator_assignments']) and any((c.get('role') in ['qualified assembly operator', 'assembly operator', 'Qualified assembly operator', 'Assembly operator', 'assembly_operator', 'qualified_assembly_operator']) and (c.get('person') == 'Luis' or c.get('name') == 'Luis') for c in decisions['operator_assignments'])
content_checks.C5: any(('customer deviation' in c.get('detail', '').lower() or 'deviation' in c.get('detail', '').lower()) and 'production order' in c.get('detail', '').lower() and ('attach' in c.get('detail', '').lower() or 'link' in c.get('detail', '').lower()) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any('roster' in c.get('detail', '').lower() and 'production board' in c.get('detail', '').lower() and 'nia' in c.get('detail', '').lower() and 'omar' in c.get('detail', '').lower() and 'luis' in c.get('detail', '').lower() and ('update' in c.get('detail', '').lower() or 'reflect' in c.get('detail', '').lower()) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The customer deviation changes the provisional 900-unit run to exactly 480 units, changes inspection to 100% torque verification by two specified roles, and requires the deviation to be attached to the production order.
The roster check changes the staffing plan to Nia, Omar, and Luis in the specified roles and requires the roster board to be updated.
